sdks.name: Firebase Analytics

collected.note: Vendor lists 'App-instance ID' (automatic) and 'Android Advertising ID' (can be disabled via Analytics data collection configuration). Vendor does not use Play type names or Play purposes; mapping derived from vendor description.
Vendor: 'Derives coarse location data from the masked IP addresses of the device.' Mapping derived.
Vendor: collects in-app purchase and subscription events with product ID, product name, and price. Mapping derived.
Vendor: 'Collects screen views and sessions for use in Reporting and Analysis.' Mapping derived.
Only if the developer sets a User-ID.

sdks.conditions: Vendor page does not assign Play categories or purposes; Advertising ID and app-instance ID collection are configurable; signed-in account info is collected only if Google Signals is enabled; sharing depends on Google Signals, Google Ads linking and Data Sharing Settings.

sdks.name: Firebase Crashlytics

collected.note: Vendor: collects stack traces, relevant application state and point-in-time device metadata when an application crashes. Mapping to Play type derived; vendor states use is 'to enable crash reporting and crash management services'.
Vendor: Crashlytics installation UUID, used to measure the number of users impacted by a crash. Mapping derived.
Only if the developer attaches free-text user IDs to crash reports.

sdks.conditions: Vendor page does not use Play type names or purposes; also collects developer-attached custom keys, logs and non-fatal events; uses Google Analytics breadcrumb logs if Analytics is included and Remote Config rollout metadata if Remote Config is included; depends on Firebase Installations and Sessions SDKs. 'shared: false' is based on Firebase's statement that it does not transfer this data to third parties except subprocessors or as directed by the developer.

sdks.name: Firebase Cloud Messaging

collected.note: Via the Firebase Installations SDK dependency: Firebase installation ID (FID), which the vendor says 'does not uniquely identify a user or physical device'. Mapping derived; vendor says Installations requires separate disclosure.

sdks.conditions: Vendor page does not use Play type names or purposes; automatically collects the app version (for topic subscription) and the Firebase user agent; message delivery metrics are sent to BigQuery only if the BigQuery export is enabled; notification interaction events are logged via Google Analytics only if Analytics is included.

sdks.name: Firebase Performance Monitoring

collected.note: Vendor: app performance metrics during the app lifecycle, CPU/memory usage, and device metadata. Mapping derived.
Vendor: 'Collects the IP address to map performance events to the countries they originate from.' Mapping derived.
Via the Firebase Installations SDK dependency (FID). Mapping derived.

sdks.conditions: Vendor page does not use Play type names or purposes; also collects custom traces, metrics and attributes the developer instruments; depends on Installations, Remote Config and Sessions SDKs.

sdks.name: Google Mobile Ads (AdMob)

collected.note: Vendor lists 'IP address', 'which may be used to estimate the general location of a device'.
Vendor: 'User product interactions', including app launch, taps, and video views.
Vendor: 'Diagnostic information' including app launch time, hang rate, and energy usage.
Android ad ID, app set ID and, if applicable, signed-in account identifiers. Vendor: 'Android ad ID collection is optional.'

sdks.conditions: Table applies to SDK 25.5.0; vendor states data is collected and shared 'for advertising, analytics, and fraud prevention purposes' without per-type purposes; ad ID collection can be prevented via the manifest; Limited Ads may disable ad ID and other data; optional features may add collection.

sdks.name: Adjust

collected.note: Vendor names only the 'App activity' category: sessions/app launches (activity resume and pause) collected by default. No specific Play type given.
Google Advertising ID with Android ID fallback on Google Play devices; not read when the user opts out via COPPA or Google Kids settings.
Only if the purchase verification SDK is integrated.

sdks.conditions: Purposes are stated for Adjust's data use overall, not per type; Developer communications, Advertising or marketing and Personalization apply only if the developer configures integrations/exports; any personal info (including hashed emails) sent via custom parameters must be disclosed by the developer.

sdks.name: Branch

collected.note: Vendor label 'Page Views and Taps in App'; can be blocked until the user opts in via Branch privacy controls.
Vendor marks OPTIONAL, e.g. if Branch measures in-app purchases.
Clicks, installs and purchases collected on the developer's behalf.

sdks.conditions: Purposes and collected/shared answers are given once for all data, not per type; vendor also lists 'Other Data' (engagement data, device metadata such as screen size and OS version), which is not a Play data type; data is not processed ephemerally.

sdks.name: OneSignal

collected.note: Collected by default if the app has in-app purchases; vendor gives 'Analytics' as the minimum purpose.
Session counts, durations and notification clicks; vendor gives these as minimum purposes.
Only if the app collects it and sends it to OneSignal.
Only if added to OneSignal.
Only if added to OneSignal.
Only if collected via Tags or Outcomes.
Only if collected via Tags or Outcomes.
Only if collected via Tags or Outcomes.
Only if collected via Tags or Outcomes.
Only if collected via Tags or Outcomes.
GAID not collected by default; collected if Aliases are used to link identifiers.

sdks.conditions: Most collection depends on data the developer sends (Tags, Outcomes, email/SMS subscriptions, location, Aliases); sharing, optionality and encryption answers appear only in screenshots and could not be read.

sdks.name: Unity Ads

collected.note: Vendor label 'Personal identifiers'.
Vendor label 'Page views and taps in the app'; only during the ad experience, not during gameplay.
Vendor label 'Other app activity' (app usage times); only when Acquire Optimization is enabled in the Monetization dashboard.
Vendor label 'App diagnostics'.

sdks.conditions: Disclosures cover the Unity Ads SDK only; no SDK version stated; data is not processed ephemerally.

sdks.name: ironSource/LevelPlay

collected.note: Interaction with ads.

sdks.conditions: No SDK version stated; page does not say whether mediated ad network adapters are covered, so mediated networks need their own disclosures.

sdks.name: Braze

collected.note: Session activity collected by default; other activity depends on the app's custom integration.
Vendor: 'we collect information on when users have opened or read these messages'.
Crash logs for errors within the SDK.
Braze-generated device ID.

sdks.conditions: Vendor: the SDK 'collects data as configured by the app developer'; approximate location, health info, emails and other user-generated content are 'Not collected by default'; no purposes or sharing answers given.

sdks.name: Bugsnag

collected.note: Breadcrumbs; can be limited via enabledBreadcrumbTypes or onBreadcrumb.
Internal SDK crash reports can be disabled via the telemetry option.
Application information captured by default.
Generated device ID and a generated user ID when no user is set; both can be overridden.

sdks.conditions: User data set via setUser links reports to a user; session tracking on by default (autoTrackSessions); React Native/Expo/Unity/Unreal capture additional interaction and navigation breadcrumbs; custom metadata is out of scope of the vendor page.
